name: MEL01C

address.note: changed from 399 Palmers Rd: OSM building tags put MEL01C and MEL01D on 369 Palmers Rd, and Wyndham application WYP14522/24 (Mar 2024) for a 'utility installation (data centre)' is at 369 Palmers Rd (source 6). 369 was a separate parcel (2020 restricted-retail application WYP12337/20). STACK/ITK/Baxtel give the campus address 399 Palmers Road

lat.note: geocoded: centroid of OSM building "Stack Infrastructure MEL01C", 369 Palmers Rd

builder.note: Hickory MEL01C&D page: 'Hickory have been contracted to build MEL01C&D' (three-level building; architect Genton, services engineer ARUP; page oddly says 'located in Laverton'); topping out Nov 2025 (source 2)

mw_it.note: STACK MEL01 page: MEL01C and MEL01D 54MW each (campus 180MW with A and B)

cost_aud_m.note: STACK closed AU$1.3bn green financing on 23 Jul 2025 'to fund the next phase of development at its MEL01 hyperscale campus' (source 5, fetched) - financing, not a stated project cost, and covers C and D together

authority.note: attributed by address: WYP14522/24 is at 369 Palmers Rd, where OSM places MEL01C/D; applicant not shown on PlanningAlerts. Application covers C and D together

pathway.note: 'use and development of the land to construct a utility installation (data centre) and the alteration of access to land in a Public Acquisition Overlay'

lodged.note: received by Wyndham ~20 Mar 2024 (PlanningAlerts found it 26 Mar 2024, 6 days after receipt)

construction_start.note: not found; permit application lodged Mar 2024, topped out Nov 2025

construction_end.note: topped out: Hickory news dated 19 Nov 2025 (source 2). Baxtel (source 4, fetched) lists MEL01C as under construction, expected 2026. Not a confirmed completion date

open_questions: construction start and completion dates not confirmed
planning: WYP14522/24 attributed by address only (applicant and decision not seen)
address: 369 (OSM, permit) vs 399 Palmers Rd (operator/aggregators) - 369 adopted
